questions.question: For N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃, DeltaH = -92 kJ/mol. Predict effect on yield of: (a) increasing pressure, (b) increasing temperature, (c) adding Fe catalyst

points.text: (a) 4 mol gas -> 2 mol gas: shift right -> higher yield. (b) Exothermic: heating shifts left -> lower yield. (c) Catalyst speeds up both forward/reverse equally -> no effect on yield, reaches equilibrium faster

markScheme.exemplarAnswer: (a) 4 mol gas -> 2 mol gas: shift right -> higher yield. (b) Exothermic: heating shifts left -> lower yield. (c) Catalyst speeds up both forward/reverse equally -> no effect on yield, reaches equilibrium faster
